sn26.10:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Yo kho bhikkhave rūpassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || || Yo vedanāya || Yo saññāya || Yo saṅkhārānaṃ || || Yo viññāṇassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || || Yo ca bhikkhave rūpassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo dukkhasseso nirodho rogānaṃ vūpasamo jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo || || Yo vedanāya || || Yo saññāya || || Yo saṅkhārānaṃ || || Yo viññāṇassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo || dukkhasseso nirodho rogānaṃ vūpasamo jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo ti || || Uppāda-saṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ || || Tassuddānaṃ || ||
sn26.10:2.0: Cakkhu {Rūpañca} Viññāṇaṃ || Phasso ca Vedanāya ca || Saññāya || Cetanā || Taṇhā || Dhātu Khandhena te dasā ti || || Sāvatthi || || Tatra ||
